text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Something's definitely off, right? 
Not just City, but Jordan too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Seems like something happened... 
maybe.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Alright! I'm gonna go catch up to those 
two! 
It'll be faster if we just talk to them 
directly!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wait! Hmm... How about we wait for them to 
cool off first? 
We don't really know what's going on, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
We don't know, which is why we gotta go 
check! 
It's no use just standing around talking 
amongst ourselves!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I mean, you're right, but... 
Even if you catch them, you know...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Neither of them are honest with their 
feelings, which is probably why things got 
so awkward. 
If you push them to talk, they might just 
get even more stubborn.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... But I want to do something. If the 
Summer Walk 
ends like this... it'd just be way too 
sad!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
City was looking forward to this so much. 
She crammed all her work 
ahead of time, and she spent all her time 
in our room researching stuff!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
She'd never say it out loud... 
but anyone could tell how happy she was to 
go with Jordan!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
If they're precious friends, you can't run 
away no matter what happens! 
You have to put it into words and share 
your true feelings head-on!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Friends forever! 
Besties for short~☆ Like BFFs!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey Pal-chin, you're coming with me to the 
next Summer Walk, right? 
I've got so many things I wanna do—I 
totally need my bestie with me☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Besties~~! Isn't our castle the absolute 
coolest?! 
Pal-chin is truly the greatest☆ Luv ya, 
wuv you so much♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, you're right. Having it put into 
words would be such a relief. I see...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Though neither of them is the type to show 
their true feelings easily, right...? 
...Guess that means it's our turn to step 
in!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Palmer-chin, Bamboo~! Listen to this! 
Jordan's over there bursting out laughing 
all by herself... It's kinda crazy!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Perfect timing, bestie! How'd you feel 
about taking part in 'Operation Youth'?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I'm in! Let's do it! Gonna rock that 
youthful spirit~~~~! ...Wait, what's that, 
though?â

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
âOho! Sounds dope, sounds dope! Ain't 
that super youthful!? Alright then... for 
now, I'm good to just hang with Jordan 
till the time comes, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You got it! Bamboo, you're still in the 
middle of your patrol, right? Meet up with 
us once you're done! And as for me...â

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... Idiot.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(Why did I have to say it so harshly...? I 
was super rude to the upperclassmen, too. 
...Ugh, I'm the worst.)

Hey there, pretty lady! Care to grab a cup 
of coffee with me?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: No thanks. ...Wait, Palmer-san?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, pick-up attempt failed! Guess I 
should've gone for a smoother line.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry. You came to check on me, 
right? But I'm fine, really.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...It's just, you and I haven't really had 
a chance to chat, City. We've both been 
running around since getting here, haven't 
we?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Won't you join me for a cup? I found this 
really delicious coffee. Let's take a 
breather and chat. ...About whatever you 
want, okay?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
â...I just got hurt on my own. Jordan 
was so obviously trying to brush it off. 
Something definitely happened, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
That just... really, really pissed me off. 
Seriously, it's shocked me how much... I 
couldn't keep my composure.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It's my fault for falling asleep. But even 
so... I lashed out at her so harshly... I 
just hate myself right now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Honestly, I'm surprised.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You're usually pretty polite around us, 
aren't you, City? So it's amazing to see 
how much of your true self comes out 
around Jordan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It's precisely because you trust her 
completely that you can let your guard 
down... like falling sound asleep, or 
letting her see your frustration, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, that's true. I just assume she'll 
understand. ...Though I don't really know. 
Maybe... maybe I'm taking too much for 
granted.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Friends really are tough, after all... 
Jordan's the first person I've ever had 
like this...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
If she hadn't reached out to me and 
forcibly dragged me into her circle... I 
wouldn't have any friends even now, and I 
never would've met you guys, Palmer-san.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
No holding back, no calculating... being 
able to just be yourself felt so nice. 
...I thought that's the kind of 
relationship we had.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... I'm pathetic. Aren't I just 
spinning my wheels? Jordan probably 
doesn't even care anymore.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...The fact that you're agonizing over 
this just shows how important she is to 
you, right? That's not a bad thing at all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
What matters is actually communicating how 
you feel, City... and checking in with her 
instead of just assuming, 'This must be 
how it is.'

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
âI'm sorry for making you listen to all 
this. Thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
No apologies allowed! That makes me feel 
lonelyâI'm your friend too, remember? 
I'm much happier when you lean on me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right. There's just one thing I need 
you to promise me! âMake sure you head 
back to the hotel by evening! ...Promise 
me, okay!?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...? Y-Yes, sureâ
